replay_start.description: Start offset for replay in seconds; 0 means from the beginning

replay_end.description: End offset for replay in seconds; 0 means unlimited

replay_duration.description: Alternative way to specify end offset as delta (seconds)

start_grace.description: Grace period before replay starts, in seconds (for pipe warming)

with_conflicts.description: Allow conflicting writes (may cause damaged I/O)

with_partial.description: Enforce partial ordering by pushing back conflicts (default)

with_ordering.description: Enforce total ordering in case of conflicts

fill_random.description: Percentage of data blocks filled with random bytes

with_final_verify.description: Run an additional verification pass at the end

with_paranoia.description: Re-read after each write (very high overhead)

o_sync.description: Use O_SYNC flag for synchronous writes

dry_run.description: Skip actual I/O, measure internal overhead only

fake_io.description: Skip lseek() and tags (even less overhead)

simulate_io.description: Simulated I/O delay in 'sec.nsec' timespec format

bottleneck.description: Maximum number of requests on the dispatch queue (0=unlimited)

mmap_mode.description: Use mmap() instead of read()/write() (not yet implemented)
